spec.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "system" and
    r._field == "uptime" and
    (
      r.host == "proxmox1"
      or r.host == "proxmox2"
      or r.host == "proxmox3"
      or r.host == "pbs"
    )
  )
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "_value"])

from(bucket: "offsite-backup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "node_cpu_seconds_total" and
    r.mode == "idle"
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "instance"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["instance"])
  |> last()

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

from(bucket: "offsite-backup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    (r._measurement == "node_memory_MemTotal_bytes" or r._measurement == "node_memory_MemFree_bytes")
    and r.host == "offsite-backup"
  )
  |> last()

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"


from(bucket: "proxmox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "blockstat" and
    (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total") and
    r.host == "pbs" and
    r.datastore == "tank"
  )
  |> last()
  |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "used", "total"])

from(bucket: "nas")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "node_cpu_seconds_total" and
    r._field == "counter" and
    r.mode == "idle"
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "instance"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["instance"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 1.0 - r._value }))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "nas"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "nas"])

from(bucket: "offsite-backup")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "node_cpu_seconds_total" and
    r._field == "counter" and
    r.mode == "idle"
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "instance"])
  |> mean()
  |> group(columns: ["instance"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 1.0 - r._value }))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "backup"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "backup"])

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.entity_id == "server_plug_power" and
    r._field == "value"
  )
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
